channel.title: Tool Site HOT
channel.description: Tool Site HOT lists only tool websites you can use right away — converters, formatters, image tools, code tools and more. It discovers the newest tool sites every day from Product Hunt, Hacker News and other tool sources, scores them by rules, and shows only the title, a one-line summary and a link to the original — no articles, no news, no full text republished.

item.title: AshuTeacher – Free AI tutor with voice blackboard and thesis studio
item.description: A free AI tutor that teaches on a voice-narrated blackboard, solves scanned exam papers step by step, and builds courses, quizzes and flashcards around any exam syllabus.

item.title: Napizo: Free Online Toolbox
item.description: 13 free tools for images, PDFs, AI and text — no sign-up, everything runs right in your browser.

item.title: Ploid
item.description: A living index of over two billion people, built as a data layer for AI agents to search, research, and enrich — describe who you are looking for and get an evidence-backed list back.

item.title: Onset
item.description: Connect your YouTube channel and get a review 48 hours after every upload, comparing click-through and retention against your own average, then draft your next title, thumbnail, and video brief from what worked.

item.title: Spaceora: AI Home Design
item.description: AI home design with real furniture from IKEA and Amazon, matched to your country and budget.

item.title: Animate Old Photos

item.title: Domainyze: Free Domain Expiry, WHOIS, DNS and SSL Checks
item.description: Check if a domain is available and when it expires, run WHOIS and DNS lookups, test SSL certificates, and build SPF and DMARC records — no signup needed.

item.title: FileSwiss: Free, Private File Tools That Run 100% in Your Browser
item.description: A suite of file tools that runs entirely in your browser — nothing is uploaded, free and private.

item.title: AI Stem Splitter | Split Songs Into 12 Stems, WAV & MIDI
item.description: Split a song into up to 12 stems — lead and backing vocals, drums, bass, guitar and more — then mix and export WAV and MIDI in the browser.

item.title: RemoveText.video | Remove Text from Video Online

item.title: SongStory

item.title: AI Image to Image by PictCraft
